hardware_dossier.transmitter: Across the violet-mist chasm on the ethereal planet Kaelen-V rises a monolithic sanctuary of fluted white-alabaster parabolic shells, crowned at its apex by a colossal needle-thin golden-brass harmonic antenna spire with suspended geometric resonance rings.
hardware_dossier.feedline_anomaly: The sanctuary's fluted shells act as giant acoustic-to-electromagnetic parabolic horns coupled to the planet's piezo-opalescent crystal arches. Every twilight at 0400 GCT when the two tall, pearlescent-skinned alien ascetics (Auren-7 and Vael-9) bow in unison on the obsidian terrace, the golden spire ignites in a luminous corona that radiates simultaneously on 9,290 kHz shortwave, 1,420.4 MHz Hydrogen line, and 632 nm optical!
hardware_dossier.receive_antenna_at_gor9: Simultaneous Lock: Apex Ring #2 (9290 kHz) + Cryo-Maser (21cm)

characters.signature_quote: Where the stars are torn by static, let our golden spire tune the void... Tal-vihara, shanti-vel: our resonators bring peace to the galaxy.
characters.bio: Standing at the focal point of Vael-Vihara's central fluted shell, Auren-7 leads the twilight antiphony. The ascetics of Kaelen-V believe that warfare, fear, and loneliness across the Orion-Perseus arm are symptoms of phase-dissonance in the interstellar medium—and that by chanting pure 3:5:1 harmonic ratios into their piezo-crystalline resonators, they are actively bringing peace to the galaxy.

[MANY — 4-Voice Choir Simultaneously]: "Tal-vihara... shanti-vel... Our resonators bring peace to the galaxy." [ONE — Lead Cantor Auren-7]: "Where the stars are divided by dissonance, let the Great Spire harmonize the void." [MANY — All 5 Voices in Unison]: "O-ma-ru Vael-Kaelen... Three spectrums as one... Peace to every listening world."

characters.signature_quote: O-ma-ru Vael-Kaelen... Five voices as one shell, three spectrums as one spire—radiating peace to every listening world.
characters.bio: In the Order of the Fluted Shell, each cantor's physical morphology, stature, and skin tone match their acoustic register: Vael-9 (Basso Profundo, Charon) is a towering, barrel-chested elder with a wide fluted cranial dome and deep obsidian-indigo slate skin; Leda-3 (Contralto, Leda) is fuller-figured and round-faced with warm terracotta-mahogany brown skin; Auren-7 (Lead Baritone, Argon III-C) is tall and regal with opalescent pearl-lavender skin; Orus-8 (Lyric Tenor, Orus/Aoede) is lean and wiry with seafoam-jade teal skin; and Kora-5 (High Soprano & Descant Trill, Kore) is a petite, delicate-framed young novice with warm golden-honey ochre skin.
characters.language_sample_transcript: [CANON — 5 Individual Voices Entering in Overlapping Layers]: "Vael-kora... tal-vihara... shanti-vel... From the fluted shells of Kaelen-Five, our resonators awaken..." [TUTTI — All 5 Voices Chanting Simultaneously]: "O-ma-ru Vael-Kaelen... Our resonators bring peace to the galaxy... Dissolving dissonance across the stars... Three, Five, One... Shanti-vel!"
characters.phonetic_and_conlang_notes: Simultaneous 5-Voice Polyphony: Five distinct individual voices (Charon [Bass], Orus [Tenor], Argon III-C [Cantor], Leda [Alto], Kore [Soprano]) chanting at the same time—first in staggered sacred canon and then in full 5-part choral harmony coupled to the 220/275/330/440/550 Hz resonator chord.

worldbuilding.habitat_and_culture: Kaelen-V is an ethereal, non-Earth world of translucent opalescent crystal arches, violet-and-silver mist canyons, and liquid-pearl pools under twin moons. Rising in the distance across the chasm is the Sanctuary of Vael-Vihara—a breathtaking monastery of fluted white-alabaster shells crowned by a colossal golden-brass harmonic antenna spire. Its ascetics vary widely in stature, cranial resonance geometry, and skin tone (from deep obsidian-indigo bass monks and warm terracotta-mahogany contraltos to pearl-lavender baritones, seafoam-jade tenors, and petite golden-honey sopranos) and believe their resonators are bringing peace to the galaxy.
worldbuilding.spectrum_gimmick_title: One-to-Many Call & Response + 5-Voice Polyphonic Peace Resonator (9290 kHz SW + 21-cm H-I + Optical)
worldbuilding.hauser_commentary: From the violet-mist planet Kaelen-V, 'Vael-Vihara Spire' (VJB-3X) on 9290 kilohertz—and simultaneously on 1420 megahertz hydrogen line! First you hear a solitary Lead Cantor intoning a call into their golden resonator sphere, and then four or five individual voices answer all at once in a hair-raising polyphonic choir—declaring that their resonators are bringing peace to the galaxy!

worldbuilding.qsl_animation_notes: 2-frame photorealistic animation on Kaelen-V: three contrasting Kaelen-V monks (towering obsidian-indigo Bass Vael-9, tall opalescent-pearl Lead Cantor Auren-7, and petite golden-honey Soprano Kora-5) stand serenely on the obsidian terrace (Frame A), then bow gracefully in unison (Frame B) as the colossal golden-brass spire blazes with concentric golden harmonic rings!

discovery_arc.summary: Simultaneously logged on 9290 kHz SW and 1420.4 MHz H-I: Lead Cantor Auren-7 calls out and is answered by four distinct choir voices chanting in unison that their resonators bring peace to the galaxy.
All five cantors chant simultaneously into the suspended golden armillary resonator; GOR-9's spectrum analyzer confirms the 5-voice choir reduces local ionospheric phase-noise by 14 dB!
